第2830章 一符成名（第1页）
林铭答应的同时，一旁的那名符箓宗的弟子也同时开口说道：
“贾师弟，请和我来，我来帮你进行登记！”
道谢一声，林铭才跟在了对方的身后，来到了任务区外的一处偏房之中，里面有着一名筑基期之人带着几名炼气期的弟子在里面。
见有人进来，他也是有些意外的看了这边一眼。
“怎么回事？！这么快就有人炼制出了极品符咒来了？！”
“这位是贾明，之前就以制符闻名京都，万宝楼特招他为客卿制符师，炼制出来的上品符咒，威力要比普通制符师所炼制出来的符咒大上分之一，散修之中称呼他为贾大师。刚刚在我们任务现场，当众炼制出了极品符咒冰箭符！”
一旁的弟子，拿出了空白的身份玉符进行登记。
片刻之后，就已经完成了登记，递给林铭，同时吩咐着：
“贾明，已经登记在册，你可回到住处，收拾一下东西，另外，和亲友相聚一番，等此番入了宗门，除非你踏入到筑基期境界，亦或者是执行任务，否则，无其他特殊情况，你是不得离开宗门半步的！等到升仙大会结束之时，会通过这玉符给你传音，接到传音之后，第一时间返回此地集合。”
林铭心中清楚，自己暂时就只是过了第一关而已。
接下来的这段时间，对方肯定还是要去调查一下林铭的身份背景的。
这一点上，林铭倒也并不担心什么？！
正常情况来说，根本不会有任何问题的。
调查他的身份背景，也仅仅就只是第二关而已。
进入到宗门之后，他肯定还要面临其他的审查的，修仙者的审查方式和他们普通人的审查，也肯定是有所不同的。
他也不想要有任何的麻烦，一路小心隐藏自己的身形，回转到了自己的院落之中。
这边刚刚回到了院落，他就感觉到自己的纳物袋之中，传音玉简在疯狂的颤动！

这几个传音玉简，有郑齐的，有掌柜的，也有吴辰的。
林铭都可以想象得到，这肯定是他们得知了自己炼制出极品符咒的消息，特意来进行祝贺的。
这其中的几个人还是有一些不同的。
掌柜的是从自己的口中听自己亲口承认过，知道自己是能够炼制出极品符咒的。
可这种事情，自己说自己行，与真正炼制成功，那还是有着一点不同的。
其他两人的心中或许是有所猜测，却也不太敢相信自己就能够炼制出极品符咒的。

Chapter 2830 Become famous in one stroke (page 1)
When Lin Ming agreed, the disciple of the Fu Lu Sect on the side also said at the same time:
"Junior Brother Jia, please come with me and I will help you register!"
After thanking him, Lin Ming followed him and arrived at a side room outside the mission area. Inside, there was a person in the foundation building stage and several disciples in the Qi refining stage.
Seeing someone coming in, he glanced here in surprise.
"What's going on?! Someone refined the best talisman so quickly?!"
"This is Jia Ming. He was well-known in Kyoto for his talisman making. Wanbao Tower specially recruited him to be the guest talisman maker. The top-grade talisman he refined is one-quarter more powerful than the talisman refined by ordinary talisman makers. The casual cultivators call him Master Jia. Just now at our mission site, he refined the top-quality ice arrow talisman in public!"
The disciple on the side took out a blank identity jade talisman to register.
After a while, the registration was completed, handed to Lin Ming, and at the same time commanded:
"Jia Ming, you have been registered. You can go back to your residence, pack your things, and get together with your relatives and friends. When you enter the sect, unless you have entered the foundation-building stage or are on a mission, you are not allowed to leave the sect without other special circumstances! When the Ascension Conference is over, you will be given a message through this jade talisman. After receiving the message, you will return here to gather as soon as possible."
Lin Ming knew in his heart that he had only passed the first level for the time being.
In the next period of time, the other party will definitely want to investigate Lin Ming's identity and background.
At this point, Lin Ming wasn't worried about anything? !
Normally, there won't be any problems at all.
Investigating his identity and background is only the second level.
After entering the sect, he will definitely face other censorships. The censorship methods of immortal cultivators are definitely different from the censorship of ordinary people.
He didn't want any trouble, so he carefully concealed his figure all the way back to his courtyard.
As soon as he returned to the courtyard, he felt the sound transmission jade slip in his storage bag trembling crazily!
Among these jade slips for transmitting messages, some belong to Zheng Qi, some belong to the shopkeeper, and some belong to Wu Chen.
Lin Ming could imagine that they must have come to congratulate him after hearing the news that he had refined the best talisman.
Some of these people are somewhat different.
The shopkeeper knew that he could refine the best spells from his own words.
But there is still a little difference between saying that you can do this kind of thing and actually refining it successfully.
The other two people may have some guesses in their minds, but they don't dare to believe that they can refine the best talisman.
